episodes.synopsis: A strange girl dressed like a nun appears before Yota Narukami and declares she is an omniscient god. As he attempts to return her to her house, she endeavors to prove her power to him.
episodes.title: The Day a God Descended

episodes.synopsis: Yota brings Hina to his house. Hina hatches a variety of schemes to help Yota get closer to Izanami. Yota helps his sister with a summer assignment.
episodes.title: The Day of the Melody

episodes.synopsis: Sora wakes up and tells her family about her friend's failing ramen restaurant. Hina hatches a plan to save it. Meanwhile, a mysterious boy returns to Japan.
episodes.title: The Day the Angel Falls

episodes.synopsis: Hina finds out about Yota's celebrity crush. If Yota can execute Hina's latest scheme, he may have a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
episodes.title: The Day of Battling Tiles

episodes.synopsis: While studying with Izanami at the library, Yota learns of trouble in the Izanami family. He and Hina want to help, but the issue is so great it looks like magic will be required to solve it.
episodes.title: The Day of Grand Magic

episodes.synopsis: Yota wants to study, but Hina is dying to go to the summer festival. Yota calls together the members of their motley crew to make summer memories.
episodes.title: The Day of the Festival

episodes.synopsis: Sora needs Yota and Hina's help to shoot a movie. Hiroto's investigations of Dr. Korogi may finally bear fruit.
episodes.title: The Day of Filming

episodes.synopsis: Yota becomes motivated to learn more about where Hina came from. Finding out more entails traveling to a beach far from his home town. Since Hina has never seen the ocean, the two take the trip together.
episodes.title: The Day of the Trip to the Beach

episodes.synopsis: Hiroto's investigation finally leads him to uncover Dr. Korogi's secret. What will this mean for Hina and Yota?
episodes.title: The Day of the Deicide

episodes.synopsis: The end of the world has come and gone. Yota's efforts to find Hina turn up nothing. However, a lead is sitting under Yota's nose. Will he realize before it is too late?
episodes.title: Days That Pass By

episodes.synopsis: Yota has finally found Hina, but she recoils at his touch. Yota's false identity will only last 2 weeks. Can he turn the situation around before then?
episodes.title: Days of Play

episodes.synopsis: Yota's time at Yamada Sanatorium is coming to an end. Will he have to say goodbye to Hina forever?
episodes.title: The Day You Choose
